findings.issue: Missing JWT authentication guard - InterviewsController does not declare @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard) at the class level, leaving all interview endpoints unprotected
findings.fix: Add @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard) decorator to InterviewsController class like ProfilesController and other protected controllers

findings.issue: No retry logic in answer evaluation - evaluateAnswer makes a single AI service request with no retry loop despite requirement for 3-attempt retry
findings.fix: Implement 3-attempt retry loop with exponential backoff before falling back to heuristic scoring

findings.issue: No score validation from AI responses - AI evaluation scores are persisted without checking they're within 0-100 bounds, potentially corrupting aggregate calculations
findings.fix: Add validation: if (score < 0 || score > 100) use fallback score before saving evaluation records

findings.issue: Interview state not reverted on question generation failure - startInterview changes status to IN_PROGRESS before generateNextQuestion, leaving interview stuck if generation fails
findings.fix: Wrap question generation in try-catch and revert status to CREATED on failure

findings.issue: No transaction boundaries for multi-step operations - submitAnswer, completeInterview, and startInterview perform multiple database writes without transactions, risking inconsistent state on partial failure
findings.fix: Wrap multi-step state transitions in TypeORM transactions using queryRunner or @Transaction decorator
